verdict.rationale: Orrick's Technology Transactions practice page explicitly lists advising on dual-licensed (open source and proprietary) software and on open source policy development and compliance, which directly matches the story for its tech-company clients. It is a single line within a broader practice description rather than a dedicated offering. Missing for 10: a dedicated OSS-compliance service page or detailed scope (e.g., license audits, policy templates, M&A OSS diligence), and independent or client corroboration.
